RagShortTexts: In 1265 at Evesham, Prince Edward encircled Simon de Montfort along the Avon loops,.

Variants.Content: On August 4, 1265, Prince Edward trapped Simon de Montfort's outnumbered force within a loop of the River Avon at Evesham. Amidst an ominous summer thunderstorm, royalist knights offered no quarter, slaughtering Montfort and dismembering his corpse on Green Hill.
While restoring Henry III, Edward absorbed Montfort's parliamentary framework to govern an increasingly modern England.
